Data:Craft.seastories witching.tisane gr.Label: Craft: Witching Tisane
Data:Craft.seastories witching.tisane gr.StartDescription: Here where the sea sounds, I can mix a tide-touched tisane. (Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I soak Fabric in the brew, I can twist it into a Grailful little cloth doll.)
Data:Craft.seastories witching.tisane gr.Desc: It's best when it's warm; but it'll keep.

Data:Craft.serpents.venoms bisclavrets.k.Label: Craft: Bisclavret's Knot
Data:Craft.serpents.venoms bisclavrets.k.StartDescription:
Use my own tears to trace a sigil of regret. 

[Serpents & Venoms with Prentice-level <sprite name=scale> creates Bisclavret's Knot. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: mix a Liquid with my hallowed tears, to clarify it into a Knock-toxin.]

Data:Craft.serpents.venoms midnight.mark.Label: Craft: Midnight Mark
Data:Craft.serpents.venoms midnight.mark.StartDescription:
Concentrate nocturnal resonances with a careful sigil. 

[Serpents & Venoms with Prentice-level <sprite name=moon> creates Midnight Mark. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: if I use this with an Egg, I'll hatch something mischievous and silvery.]
Data:Craft.serpents.venoms midnight.mark.Desc: The Mark shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, but that's mostly because it looks surprisingly ugly in sunlight.

Data:Craft.sharps torgues.cleansing edge.Label: Craft: Torgue's Cleansing
Data:Craft.sharps torgues.cleansing edge.StartDescription:
Purge myself of harmonious resonances, accruing some personal Edge. It won't be pleasant. 

[Sharps with Prentice-level <sprite name=edge> creates Torgue's Cleansing. Or for a Scholar-level recipe: add something with a Memory aspect, and I have the makings of a significant Edge Memory.]
Data:Craft.sharps torgues.cleansing edge.Desc: The Cleansing has left my skin burning, my teeth throbbing. The Corrivality rumbles beneath the membraneous surfaces of the waking world.

Data:Craft.sickle.eclipse tincture.labhi.StartDescription:

Data:Craft.sickle.eclipse tincture.labhi.Desc: As it clarifies, the Tincture vibrates judderingly. This is called 'growling'.

Data:Craft.solutions.separations materia.Label: Craft: Westcott's Compounds

[Solutions & Separations with Prentice-level <sprite name=moth> creates Westcott's Compounds. Or for a Scholar-level recipe:  if I include a Memory and smoke the preparation while it's fresh, I'll gain a riddlesome insight.]
Data:Craft.solutions.separations materia.Desc: Westcott probably didn't invent all these, but he knew how to make a name stick.
